meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Deposit insurance by bank group: insured banks, assessable and insured deposits, and the insured share, each year (also report 938)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 733 (data provider DP3), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Amounts in ₹ crore; counts as numbers; ratios in per cent, as each row's label says. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (9 values, e.g. All SCBS, Percentage of Insured Deposits on 2023-03-01; District central co-operative banks, Percentage of Insured Deposits on 2023-03-01; Foreign banks, Percentage of Insured Deposits on 2023-03-01).
